Key Account Manager – New Business (m/w/d) | Retail & Brand Signage
Full-time (40 hours per week), Hybrid (Berlin, Germany)

About Us
At The Global Talent Co., we provide opportunities to work with leading innovative technology companies worldwide, offering stable employment, competitive compensation, career growth, and access to a community of 25,000+ like-minded marketing professionals.

About the Company
You’ll be joining a Berlin-headquartered company that has spent over a decade becoming one of Europe’s go-to partners for premium custom signage. Its work appears in flagship stores, showrooms, hotels and offices for well-known brands in retail, luxury, automotive, hospitality and tech. Clients come back for repeat orders and multi-location rollouts, and the team is now building a dedicated new business function to match that reputation.

The Role
As Key Account Manager – New Business, you’ll open doors with enterprise brands across Germany and Europe and turn first conversations into signed signage projects. This is a hunter role: no inherited book. Once a client signs, an experienced internal team handles all delivery, so your time goes into pipeline, new accounts and growing relationships.

You’ll work directly with the founder-led leadership team and have real autonomy over your approach. You probably work at a brand experience or shopper marketing agency, a POS or visual merchandising supplier, a Ladenbau or Messebau company, an event agency, or a large-format print house today. You enjoy getting in front of brand and retail marketing decision-makers and want a product that sells itself once you’re in the room.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and win new enterprise brand accounts, from first outreach to signed contract

  • Build relationships with Heads of Brand, Retail Marketing, Visual Merchandising and senior marketing leaders

  • Navigate buying processes involving marketing, retail operations and procurement

  • Scope signage projects with clients and brief the internal team clearly from day one

  • Lead pricing negotiations and shape deal structures that protect margin

  • Grow accounts through repeat orders, upsell and multi-location rollouts

  • Keep your pipeline clean and up to date in the CRM

  • Represent the company at selected trade fairs and events such as EuroShop

Ideal Candidate

  • 2+ years in new business, key account or sales roles, selling to senior decision-makers on high-value deals

  • Native-level German and professional English; based in or able to work hybrid from Berlin

  • A genuine hunter: you build pipeline from scratch and are driven by ambitious goals

  • A track record of opening doors and building a network among brand, marketing or retail contacts

  • Structured pipeline management and CRM discipline that keeps complex deals moving

  • Commercial acumen: you think in margins, pricing and deal structures, not just revenue

  • You listen first and understand what really matters to a client before you pitch

  • Mature, confident and energising to work with

Nice to Have

  • A background in brand experience, retail or shopper marketing agencies, POS and visual merchandising, Ladenbau, Messebau, event agencies with retail or gastro clients, or large-format production

  • Hands-on experience with tenders, RFPs and framework agreements

  • An existing network among brand, retail marketing or visual merchandising leaders in DACH

  • Experience using trade fairs as a lead generation channel

At The Global Talent Co., our mission is to bridge the gap between leading global tech companies and amazing global talent. We believe everyone deserves equal access to opportunities, regardless of the country they happen to be born in.

Please note: This job description is written in German as the role requires fluency in German and active collaboration with German-speaking stakeholders. We want to ensure clarity around expectations and language needs from the start.

Startdatum: ab 07.09.2026 - Befristet bis 28.02.2027

Bei Klim arbeiten wir mit Landwirten und Lebensmittelunternehmen zusammen, um regenerative Landwirtschaft skalierbar und für Landwirte finanziell attraktiv zu gestalten. Über unsere Plattform unterstützen wir Landwirte dabei, die Bodengesundheit wiederherzustellen, die Artenvielfalt zu fördern und CO₂ zu binden – und gleichzeitig neue, verlässliche Einnahmequellen zu erschließen.

Als Berliner AgriTech-Startup – unterstützt durch eine Series-A-Finanzierung in Höhe von 22 Millionen US-Dollar – arbeiten wir mit führenden globalen Lebensmittelunternehmen wie Nestlé und Kaufland zusammen. Gemeinsam reduzieren wir Emissionen in deren Lieferketten und stärken die langfristige Resilienz. Seit 2020 haben wir bereits 3.500 Landwirte unterstützt, die zusammen mehr als 900.000 Hektar bewirtschaften.

Wenn du dich für ein nachhaltiges Ernährungssystem und echten Klimaschutz begeisterst, komm zu uns und hilf mit, einen gesünderen Planeten zu schaffen!

Deine Mission

Klim begleitet Landwirt:innen und Unternehmen bei der Umstellung auf regenerative Landwirtschaft. Klim hat eine digitale Plattform entwickelt, die den Betrieben eine einfache Möglichkeit bietet, ihre regenerativen Maßnahmen zu dokumentieren, Finanzierungen für ihre umgesetzten Maßnahmen zu erhalten und vom Fachwissen einer engagierten Community zu profitieren. Gemeinsam mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben und teilnehmenden Unternehmen setzt sich Klim mit dieser Arbeit dafür ein, den CO2-Ausstoß in der Landwirtschaft nachhaltig zu reduzieren, die Bodengesundheit zu verbessern und Artenvielfalt zu fördern. Um Qualität und Integrität der Arbeit sicherzustellen, hat Klim einen eigenen Monitoring, Reporting und Verifizierungsprozess (MRV) entwickelt.

Als Teil unseres MRV (Monitoring, Reporting and Verification)-Teams stellst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren landwirtschaftlichen Partnerbetrieben die Qualität und Transparenz unserer Ergebnisse sicher.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du arbeitest als Werkstudent:in in unserem Verifizierungsteam. Deine Aufgabe besteht in der Prüfung von Betriebsdaten hinsichtlich der umgesetzten Maßnahmen der Betriebe.

  • Du durchsichtest sorgfältig Betriebsdokumenten wie Agraranträge, Ackerschlagkartei, Düngebedarfsermittlungen, Saatgutbelege, Dienstleistungsrechnungen und Inventarlisten und überprüfst, dass die Datenlage auf unserer Plattform in Einklang mit der Dokumentation steht.

  • Mit deinem agrarwissenschaftlichen Fachwissen prüfst du die Plausibilität von den eingesetzten regenerativen Maßnahmen, wie Fruchtfolgen, Düngemittelverwendung und Bodenbearbeitung.

  • Du stehst in engem Kontakt mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben zur Klärung von Fragen.

  • Mit deiner Arbeit stellst du sicher, dass die von unserem Modell berechneten CO₂-Einspeicherungen und Einsparungen tatsächlich erreicht wurden.

Dein Profil

  • Du bist aktuell als Student:in an einer deutschen Universität eingeschrieben, vorzugsweise in Agrarwissenschaften, Umweltwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich – oder bringst praktische Erfahrungen in der Landwirtschaft mit, z.B. durch persönlichen Hintergrund

  • Du bringst großes Interesse an regenerativer Landwirtschaft und nachhaltigen Lösungen mit.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und hast Freude an der direkten Kommunikation mit landwirtschaftlichen Betrieben – telefonisch und per E-Mail.

  • Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten sind für dich selbstverständlich.

  • Du bist versiert im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

Deine Benefits

  • Growth: Einblicke in alle Arbeitsbereiche eines agilen Start-Ups und wertvolles Wissen über die moderne Arbeitswelt.

  • Opportunity: Arbeite bei einem innovativen Unternehmen für regenerative Landwirtschaft und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir unsere Ziele erreichen.

  • Impact: Dein Engagement trägt täglich zur Zukunftssicherheit der Landwirtschaft, zur Bodengesundheit und zum Klimaschutz bei.

  • Autonomy: Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Flexibles Arbeitsmodell: Wir fördern flexibles, hybrides Arbeiten und ermöglichen es dir, aus unserem Berliner Büro oder remote zu arbeiten.

  • Weitere Benefits für Mitarbeiter:innen in Deutschland: Wir bieten eine Mitgliedschaft im Urban Sports Club oder das Deutschlandticket, Team-Lunches (in Berlin) sowie regelmäßige Team-Events.

Wir freuen uns auf Dich!

Bei Klim sind wir überzeugt, dass ein lebendiger und erfolgreicher Arbeitsplatz auf den vielfältigen Hintergründen, Talenten und Perspektiven unseres Teams basiert. Gemeinsam werden wir stärker, indem wir die individuellen Stärken jeder einzelnen Person wertschätzen und weiterentwickeln.

Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich alle geschätzt fühlen und die Möglichkeit haben, ihr volles Potenzial einzubringen. Alle Einstellungs- und Personalentscheidungen treffen wir ausschließlich auf Grundlage von Qualifikationen, Leistung und den Bedürfnissen des Unternehmens – und gewährleisten so Fairness und Chancengleichheit für alle.

Wenn dich diese Position begeistert, du aber nicht jede einzelne Anforderung erfüllst, ermutigen wir dich dennoch, dich zu bewerben. Vielleicht passt du auf eine Weise perfekt zu unserem Team, die du dir noch gar nicht vorstellen kannst!

You hold the plan, the dependencies, the decisions and the readiness of every team, working closely with our founders. Once the launch is on track, you take on the next special project out of the CEO Office.

The position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Germany and includes occasional business travel. Sounds good? Then we look forward to getting to know you.
Your tasks

  • You will manage the Bikeleasing Group’s tax matters independently, initially with a focus on Germany and increasingly on international topics in the future
  • You will prepare tax returns, tax declarations, input tax refund claims and withholding tax applications carefully and on time
  • You will be responsible for tax calculations in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) as well as the IFRS reporting package for our parent company
  • You will continuously monitor, document and optimise intra-group transfer pricing
  • You will actively contribute your expertise to VAT-related matters and tax audits
  • As the central point of contact for specialist departments, external tax advisory firms and authorities, you will provide clarity on complex tax matters
  • You will further develop international tax topics and tax processes together with the relevant stakeholders


Your profile

  • A completed degree in business administration, economics or law with a focus on taxation, or a comparable qualification
  • At least five years of professional experience in the tax department of a company or at an auditing or tax advisory firm
  • In-depth knowledge of German tax law and, ideally, international tax law
  • Practical experience with accounting in accordance with the German Commercial Code (HGB) and, ideally, knowledge of IFRS
  • Familiarity with group structures and the related accounting requirements
  • A successfully completed German tax consultant examination is desirable
  • A structured and precise approach to work, as well as confidence when dealing with authorities and external partners


Why us?

Around your working day

  • Flexible working hours and flexitime help you balance work and private life.
  • Workation: Once a year, you can work remotely from another EU country—or from a country where you hold a valid work permit—for up to three weeks.
  • You’ll receive modern equipment for working both in the office and remotely.
  • Clear vision at work matters to us. If you need prescription glasses for your workplace, we’ll contribute €100 towards the cost.
  • You’ll benefit from a wide range of training opportunities and a transparent process to support your professional and personal development.
  • A summer party and regular team events give you the chance to connect and share experiences.
More for life
  • Every month, you’ll receive a €50 non-cash benefit voucher—for example, to spend on corporate fitness, groceries, DIY stores, fuel or online shopping.
  • For your birthday, you’ll receive a €60 voucher that can be redeemed with the same providers.
  • You’ll receive a €40 contribution towards capital-forming benefits.
  • You can take out an occupational pension plan with our partner, ERGO.
  • After your probationary period, you can lease up to two bicycles, e-bikes or pedelecs through us.
  • Parents receive up to five fully paid child-sick days per child each year, up to a maximum of 12 days per year.
  • We grant up to two days of special leave for certain life events.
  • With Bike2future, you get 10% off used bikes and leasing offers, plus two weeks to test the bikes you choose. With a subscription, the first four weeks are free and the €99 setup fee is waived.
  • Through Corporate Benefits and exclusive employee discounts, you’ll enjoy attractive offers from a wide range of partners.

data.description:
Overview

PR steht vor einem strukturellen Bruch. Vertrauen verschiebt sich, Sichtbarkeit wird neu verteilt, KI wächst exponentiell. Wir bei getpress glauben, dass Reputation in den nächsten zehn Jahren der entscheidende Wettbewerbsvorsprung für Unternehmen wird. Und dass die Agentur, die das ernst nimmt, anders aussehen muss als die Agentur von gestern.

Deshalb bauen wir die PR Company der Zukunft. Outcome-getrieben statt Retainer-Stunden. KI-first statt KI-on-top. Automatisiert, wo es skaliert und menschlich, wo es wirklich zählt. Unser über 40 köpfiges Team aus Journalist*innen und PR-Strateg*innen hat seit 2017 die PR für 450+ der spannendsten Wachstumsunternehmen Europas gesteuert – und hat Hunger auf mehr.

Bist du dabei?


Deine Rolle

  • Strategisch und themensicher: Du entwickelst individuelle PR Strategien für Kunden aus dem B2B- und B2C-Bereich – mit klarem Fokus auf Themenplatzierung in relevanten Medien. Dabei bringst du journalistisches Denken und strategische Kommunikation zusammen.
  • Beratend auf Augenhöhe: Du steuerst die Kommunikation mit deinen Kund*innen professionell, planst vorausschauend (z. B. mit Quartalsplänen & KPIs) und baust langfristige Beziehungen auf. Du bringst proaktiv Themen ein – und entwickelst die Kommunikation deiner Kund*innen kontinuierlich weiter. Du bist Sparringspartner*in auf C-Level-Augenhöhe, nicht Auftragsempfänger*in.
  • Teamorientiert & offen: Du teilst dein Wissen, gibst und nimmst Peer-to-Peer-Feedback über alle Erfahrungslevel hinweg, ohne Gatekeeping, mit echtem Interesse an gemeinsamer Weiterentwicklung.
  • Vorne auf der AI Welle: Du arbeitest aktiv mit unserem internen AI-Stack. Recherche, Pitch-Vorbereitung, Themen-Scouting – wo Maschinen schneller sind, lassen wir sie machen. Du investierst die gewonnene Zeit in Substanz, Beziehungen und Kreativität.
  • Aktives Netzwerken: Du baust und pflegst belastbare Beziehungen zu Journalist*innen aus den wichtigsten Medien im DACH Raum und Europas.


Wer du bist

  • 4+ Jahre Erfahrung in der operativen PR, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld, und hast Kund*innen nachweislich eigenständig in deutschen Leit- und Fachmedien platziert.
  • Du bringst fundierte Beratungskompetenz mit, analysierst Zielgruppen und Märkte, übersetzt Unternehmensziele in PR Strategien, leitest messbare Maßnahmen ab und begleitest deine Kund*innen als verlässliche* Sparringspartner*in auf Augenhöhe.
  • Du hast ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Journalist*innen und weißt, wie man vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbaut und pflegt.
  • Du beobachtest die Nachrichtenlage aktiv und erkennst Themenpotenziale, bevor andere sie auf dem Schirm haben.
  • Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, bringst dich ins Team ein und teilst dein Wissen offen.
  • Du nutzt KI-Tools pragmatisch, um Prozesse zu beschleunigen, damit mehr Zeit für inhaltliche Tiefe und kreative Ideen bleibt.
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2- Niveau, kannst auch auf Englisch professionell kommunizieren und lebst in Deutschland


Was dich erwartet

  • Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum.
  • Langfristige Perspektive & Entwicklung: Du startest mit einem unbefristeten Vertrag. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir einen klaren Fahrplan für deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung – mit regelmäßigen Feedbacks und transparenten Zielen.
  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Entscheidungsfreiheit, Eigenverantwortung und klare Kommunikation gehören für uns selbstverständlich dazu.
  • Unterstützung und offene Arme: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge.
  • Eine Kultur von Challengern. Wir arbeiten ergebnisgetrieben, feiern Erfolge und erwarten, dass du uns challenged – und wir challengen zurück. Augenhöhe heißt bei uns: ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen.
  • Eine Lernkurve, die du anderswo nicht bekommst. Du arbeitest täglich mit einem Team, das das fortschrittlichste AI PR System im Markt baut. Wer sich jetzt einbringt, baut sich ein Profil, das in der Branche selten ist.
  • Benefits und Sweet Treats: Du kannst aus drei frei wählbaren Sachbezügen wählen, von einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge mit 20% Zuschuss auf deine Einzahlungen profitieren,180 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland arbeiten, dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents freuen. Und das Beste: Du startest mit 27 Urlaubstagen aber je länger du bei uns bist, desto mehr Urlaubstage bekommst du dazu.


Unser nächsten Schritte

Wenn du jetzt denkst: ,,Klingt nach mir!’’, dann bewirb dich ohne Anschreiben bei uns und wer weiß, vielleicht bist du schon schneller als gedacht Teil unseres getpress-Teams!

Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit ein und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, sexueller Orientierung, Alter oder Behinderung.

Wir freuen uns dich kennenzulernen!
Dein People & Culture Team

data.title: Senior PR Manager (m/w/d) – Remote oder Berlin

data.description:
Overview

getpress entwickelt eine eigene KI-Agenten-Plattform (LangGraph, PostgreSQL, Next.js) für die PR-Branche


Der Servicemarkt, von Legal über Consulting bis hin zu Agenturen, steht vor der größten Transformation der Geschichte. Gleichzeitig wird der milliardenschwere PR-Markt im Zeitalter von AI-Visibility gerade immer wichtiger. getpress, eine der am schnellsten wachsenden PR-Agenturen Deutschlands (>40 Leute, Kund*innen wie Trivago, Komoot, Fonio AI oder AutoScout24), hat sich entschieden, diesen Wandel zu führen statt abzuwarten. Wir bauen die PR Company der Zukunft: keine reine Service-Company mehr, sondern eine Service-as-a-Software-Company. 


Unser AI-Team besteht nun seit 4 Monaten, aktuell ein Developer, eine Produktmanagerin und unsere Head of AI. Die Grundarchitektur steht, erste Teile unserer PR-Plattform und des Multi-Agent-Systems laufen produktiv. Jetzt fehlst du – die Person, die als Backend Engineer das technische Fundament zusammen mit unserem zweiten Developer ownt und gemeinsam neu definiert, wie die PR der Zukunft funktioniert.


Deine Rolle

  • PR-Plattform: Fullstack-Entwicklung der Plattform, die das Operating System der PR-Agentur 2027 wird. Nah an den Nutzer*innen, in schnellen Entwicklungszyklen, und wo deine Entscheidungen den Kurs setzen.

  • KI-Agenten: Aufbau eines Agenten-Systems, das die PR-Wertschöpfungskette End-to-End neu definiert. Du baust die Agenten, mit denen unsere Berater*innen täglich arbeiten, inkl. Self-Learning-Loops und Multi-Agent-Orchestrierung.

  • Systemarchitektur: Mitgestalten der Systemarchitektur, inkl. Workflows, Datenmodell, Schnittstellen, Compliance und Tech Stack (bisher vorwiegend PostgreSQL, Next.js, LangGraph, Docker)

  • Datenmanagement: Weiterentwicklung der Datenbank-Architektur inkl. relationaler Daten- und Vektor-Datenbanken


Wer du bist

Must haves:

  • > 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung

  • > 1 Jahr Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Agenten und -Komponenten wie Memory, Context-Engineering, Retrieval und Orchestration unter Verwendung von Frameworks wie Langchain, CrewAI, Langgraph o.ä.

  • Tech Stack: TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Git, LangGraph, Github

  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Backend-Systemen mit Frameworks (fastAPI, springboot, nestJS, etc.) und gängigen Programmiersprachen (z.B. Java, Typescript, Python)

  • Erfahrung mit Container-based und Cloud-native Architekturen (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS oder ähnlich)

  • C1-Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil, B2-Niveau ist ausreichend (mit Motivation in deinem ersten Arbeitsjahr den Kurs zu C1 zu machen)

Nice to haves:

  • Datenkompetenz: Sicher in SQL, API Design, Schema-Design, Query Optimization

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-/ML-Modellen in Produktionssysteme, sowie im Verständnis des Modellverhaltens, der Modellleistung und der Modellbeschränkungen

  • Product-Engineering: Erfahrung darin, Anforderungen aus Business- und Nutzer:innen-Perspektive einzuordnen, bevor sie technisch umgesetzt werden

  • Erfahrung in Event-Driven Architecture (Kafka, RabbitMQ, o.ä.)

  • Erfahrung mit Agentic Development (Claude Code, Codex, o.ä.)


Was dich erwartet

  • Architekt des Tech-Layers: Du bist unser technischer Experte und gestaltest mit, wie getpress Technologie denkt und nutzt

  • KI in Anwendung: Du bringst KI an der Vorfront technischer Möglichkeiten in unsere Prozesse und Strategie

  • Autonomie: Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Management, setzt eigene Ideen um und definierst Standards, an denen wir uns orientieren

  • Ein echtes Team: Wir begegnen einander auf Augenhöhe – offen, ehrlich und mit echtem Interesse am Gegenüber. Wir lernen voneinander, geben einander Rückhalt und feiern gemeinsame Erfolge.

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob im Berliner Office oder remote (in DE) – wir setzen auf flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wir suchen jemanden mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland. Das heißt wann und wo (in DE) du deinen Arbeitsalltag gestaltest, entscheidest du selbst. Klare Kommunikation und Vertrauen sind dabei für uns selbstverständlich.


Wie gehts weiter?

Das klingt genau nach dir?

Dann sende uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Wir freuen uns darauf dich kennenzulernen!

data.title: AI Product Engineer (m/w/d)

data.description:
Your mission

If you're studying supply chain, logistics, or business and want real hands-on experience alongside your studies, this is your chance to see the full supply chain of a scaling food company from the inside. As a Working Student in Supply Chain, you'll support our Retail Operations, Planning, and Procurement teams and help keep daily operations running smoothly.

Key responsibilities

  • Retail operations: Support the processing of EDI and email orders in SAP, prepare delivery notes and transfer orders, and help coordinate deliveries with logistics partners.

  • Supply chain planning: Help maintain stock, production, and inventory data, and support the Supply Chain Planner with planning overviews.

  • Procurement: Prepare and follow up on purchase orders, check supplier confirmations, and track deliveries of ingredients and packaging.

  • Master data: Keep product, packaging, and supplier data accurate across our systems.

  • Team support: Pick up operational tasks across the team as priorities shift, always in close coordination with the responsible team member.

  • Reporting and process improvement: Prepare regular reports on orders, stock, and purchasing, and help document and improve our supply chain processes.



Your profile

Requirements

  • Studies: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's programme in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field, ideally with at least 12 months of study remaining.

  • Availability: 16–20 hours per week during the semester, with the option to work more during semester breaks.

  • Experience: First practical experience in supply chain, logistics, or procurement (internship, previous student job) is a plus, but not a must.

  • Technical skills: Good Excel skills. First exposure to SAP or another ERP is a plus.

  • Working style: Organised, reliable, and comfortable switching between tasks and stakeholders.

  • Mindset: Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German, written and spoken.


Why us?

Why you should apply now

  • Scaling Big: We’re at an exciting inflection point, transitioning from a pilot phase to scaling operations. Be part of something transformative and build it from the ground up.

  • Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and angels who share our vision and believe in our mission.

  • The Time is Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away from animal-based meat, fast!


A word on Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
We embrace diversity and equal opportunities for all. Shared values and alignment with Project Eaden’s purpose matter most to us. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, or marital status.

Workspace and culture

data.title: Mechanical Engineer in Production [Mid-Senior; F/M/D]

data.description:
The Role

This is a senior role combining consulting, technology and commercial responsibility. You’ll work directly with customers to understand their processes and challenges, then turn those requirements into practical Smartsheet solutions. You’ll build and present proof of concepts, scope consulting projects, discuss pricing and ultimately help win the work.
You’ll play an important role in AMX’s continued growth, with an initial focus on the DACH market. You’ll work with opportunities from Smartsheet, our partner network and existing customers, while also helping develop new relationships over time. The focus is on building trust, understanding where AMX can add value and turning strong customer relationships into sustainable growth.
There’s also real scope for this role to grow. With proven success, you’ll take on broader responsibility for how AMX develops opportunities and goes to market, initially through greater ownership of customers, regions and commercial strategy. Over time, this can also develop into mentoring and guiding the team as it grows.What You’ll Be Doing

  • Manage customer opportunities end-to-end, from discovery and requirements gathering through solution design, proof of concepts, scoping, pricing and commercial discussions, before handing over to the implementation team.
  • Build strong relationships with existing customers, identifying new use cases and opportunities to expand successful solutions across other teams, departments and markets.
  • Work closely with Smartsheet Account Executives and the wider Smartsheet team on joint account planning, developing opportunities and identifying growth accounts across DACH and AMX’s wider markets.
  • Help develop new opportunities through targeted account research, strategic outreach, events and collaboration with AMX’s marketing and partner network.
  • Contribute to and help shape AMX’s wider consulting and commercial approach, including how we develop opportunities, work with partners and take solutions to market.
  • As you progress, mentor other consultants and take on increasing responsibility across AMX’s commercial activities.


Your profile

  • You have strong experience in technology consulting, solutions consulting, SaaS or digital transformation.
  • You’re commercially minded and comfortable taking a customer conversation from discovery through solution design, scoping, negotiation and close.
  • You’re equally technically hands-on and comfortable actually building and demonstrating what you propose. Smartsheet experience is a big advantage, but strong Excel skills or experience configuring SaaS, workflow, low-code or business applications can also be a great fit.
  • You’re good at asking the right questions and turning complex or unclear business problems into structured solutions.
  • You’re confident presenting to senior stakeholders and can explain technical solutions in terms of business value.
  • You enjoy building customer relationships and spotting new opportunities.
  • You’re comfortable working without a perfect playbook. You like bringing your own ideas, testing what works and helping shape the processes and approach that will make AMX successful as we grow.
  • You’re interested in growing beyond an individual contributor role, mentoring others and taking on broader responsibility over time.
  • You speak German at native/C2 level and English fluently.
  • You’re ideally based in Germany and comfortable travelling for customers, partner meetings and events, typically up to five days per month.
  • A relevant degree is welcome, but your experience and what you’ve actually delivered are much more important to us.


Why us?

  • You’ll join an established and successful consultancy that is still small enough for you to have a real influence on how things are done.
  • You’ll have genuine flexibility around where you work, with a remote-first setup and only occasional travel for customers, partner meetings and team events.
  • The role comes with a strong fixed salary, with regular salary reviews as your responsibilities and seniority grow.
  • You’ll receive a €3,000 annual learning and development budget, home-office support, a flexible €50 monthly benefits allowance, wellness and technology allowances and regular team retreats.
  • You won’t simply be executing somebody else’s playbook. You’ll have the freedom to bring your own ideas, shape how we work and help define what successful growth looks like.
  • Most importantly, there’s room for this to become much more than a typical Senior Consultant position. If things go well, we want you to take on broader commercial responsibility, help develop the team and play an important role in AMX’s continued growth across DACH and beyond.

data.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Munich or working remotely from Germany. At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you'll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures.
  • Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
  • Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.

 Your Profile:

  • 6+ years of experience in software development.
  • Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.
  • Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, including its environment and type system.
  • Extensive expertise in GraphQL.
  • Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns.
  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).
Desirable Skills:
  • Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL.
  • Experience with PHP Symfony.
  • Experience working with AWS cloud.
  • Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts.
  • Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools).

Our hiring process:

  1. TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
  2. Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
  3. Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️
    It varies from 1 to 3 interviews

*Some processes might slightly change according to needs

Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you're welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.
#LI-AK1  

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged. 

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.
Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise

Benefits

adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages Tensorflow and PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Investigate how our ML models perform in the real world and compare model assumptions and predictions with actual user and business behavior. Identify gaps between offline model performance and online outcomes and help the team close them.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Build dashboards and automated reports that make ML model performance, experiments and key business metrics transparent and easy to understand for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Act as a bridge between Data Science, Product and Business teams, translating business questions into analytical problems and turning complex ML insights into clear recommendations and decisions.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Document your analyses, methodologies and findings and build reusable analytical approaches that can be applied across models and experiments.

Who you are:

  • You have a degree in mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, economics, analytics, or a similar quantitative field.

  • You have 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Product Analytics, Experimentation, Data Science or a similar role. Experience in AdTech, mobile apps or ML-driven products is a strong plus.

  • You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy digging into data to understand why something happens, not just what happened.

  • You’re proficient in SQL and comfortable working with large datasets.

  • You have strong Python or R skills and are comfortable using them for data analysis and statistical modelling.

  • You have a solid understanding of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, statistical significance and A/B test analysis.

  • You have an understanding of machine learning concepts and model evaluation and are comfortable working with Data Scientists. You don't necessarily need to build ML models yourself, but you should understand how to assess their performance and limitations.

  • You have experience working with model and business metrics, and can connect technical model performance to real-world business outcomes.

  • You have excellent data visualization skills and experience building dashboards using tools such as QuickSight, Power BI, Tableau, R Shiny, Streamlit or similar.

  • You are comfortable communicating complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Fuel for the Journey: Benefits to Support Your Ambitions

  • Invest in Your Future: Regular feedback and our development program support your growth, helping you expand your skill set and achieve your career goals.

  • Easy Arrival to adjoe: From signing to settling in Hamburg, we’ve got you covered. Need a visa? No problem. Ready to build your new life and career at adjoe in Hamburg? We support every ambition—from learning German to a relocation bonus that helps you settle in and make Hamburg feel like home.

  • Live Your Best Life, at Work and Beyond: We work in a hybrid setup with 3 core office days, plus flexible working hours. Enjoy 30 vacation days, 3 weeks of remote work per year, and free access to an in-house gym with lots of different fitness classes and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP).

  • Thrive Where You Work: Enjoy the Alster lake view from our central office with top notch equipment, fun open spaces, and a large variety of snacks and drinks.

  • Join the Community! Participate in regular team and company events, including hackathons and social gatherings. We work together, and we celebrate together, too.

data.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.

This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:

OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP

  • Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

  • Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

  • Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS

  • Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

  • Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

  • Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

METERING & BILLING PLATFORM

  • Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

  • Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

  • Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT

  • Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

  • Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

  • Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

  • Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

  • Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

  • Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

  • Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting for direction.

  • Exceptional communication: You're equally at home with engineers, the Finance team, and Sales, and you can make billing trade-offs legible to all of them.

  • Enterprise reality: You understand what self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments mean for licensing and metering.

Nice-to-haves

  • Usage-based billing: You've owned usage-based or hybrid (subscription plus usage) billing.

  • Vendor billing stacks: You've worked hands-on with Paddle, Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora or similar, and know where they break at enterprise contract volume.

  • Migration experience: You've run a billing-provider migration.

  • Hands-on ability: You can read code, query data, or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

  • CRM integration: You've worked on Salesforce or CRM-to-billing integrations.

  • Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, agent orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

  • Writing culture: You default to writing things down to create clarity and alignment.

Why join us?

At n8n, you'll be in the middle of the AI revolution. The shift from deterministic automation to agent autonomy is a genuinely open design space, and n8n has a credible claim to owning it. Every plan we sell, every enterprise contract, and every agent run that gets metered and billed runs on the foundation you own: licensing, entitlements, accounts, and the billing platform across Cloud and Enterprise. Your work directly shapes how n8n makes money and how easily customers can buy, grow, and trust what they pay for, from self-serve Cloud to air-gapped and OEM deployments.

You'll join one of Europe's fastest growing startups at the sweet spot: small enough to have real impact and be empowered, big enough that your work already reaches massive scale and serious enterprise customers. You'll work with experienced engineers, Finance, and go-to-market on problems where the details are the product, in an AI-native, empowered culture of humble, kind, yet driven and direct people, where you're hired to think, not just to execute. And with our fair-code model, a passionate open-source community gives you a direct feedback loop on everything you ship.

About the Role:

Hi there! We're hiring a Public Sector Enterprise Account Executive II to join our Sales team.

Our sales team is tenured, technically curious, and genuinely invested in doing right by the customer. We partner closely across the business, and we operate with a lot of trust: you're given real ownership over your territory, and you're expected to bring your own judgment to how you build it.

As an Enterprise Account Executive II, you'll own the full sales cycle for a defined set of Public Sector enterprise accounts, from first conversation through negotiation and close, partnering with sales engineering, customer success, and your manager to navigate complex deals. This role matters because enterprise wins are how Camunda grows its footprint in large accounts, and how we prove the platform works at scale.

This role gives you a book of enterprise accounts to grow and a real say in how you build your territory. You'll work complex deals with multiple stakeholders, and you'll have the support of sales engineering and customer success behind you as you build credibility and close. Camunda’s capabilities are well-aligned to the use cases that will help the DACH Administration digitize and automate for more efficiency and agility - this is an opportunity to shape and build a large and meaningful business!

What You Will Do

  • Build a territory plan that identifies Land opportunities and Expand possibilities, leveraging your extended resources such as Partners, Marketing, Inside Sales, Customer Success.

  • Build account plans that identify whitespace, map stakeholders, and set a realistic path to close.

  • Navigate multi-stakeholder buying committees, including technical, business, and economic buyers.

  • Own and execute the full sales cycle, from prospecting through negotiation and close.

  • Partner with sales engineering and customer success to build technical credibility and ensure a smooth handoff and adoption after close.

  • Represent Camunda's value to business and technical buyers, tailoring the message to what each audience actually cares about.

  • Solid experience closing enterprise software deals end-to-end in DACH, with a track record across multiple full sales cycles. You know what it takes to move a deal from first meeting to signature without losing momentum.

  • Efficient balance between driving towards a customer vision and achieving short-term projects towards this horizon.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with own initiative. The playbook will not provide all answers in advance!

  • Comfort navigating multi-stakeholder enterprise environments. You've worked complex deals involving IT, business, and procurement stakeholders, and you know how to keep everyone moving in the same direction.

  • Developing territory and account planning instincts, orchestrating resources efficiently. You can build a plan with some independence, not just work from a list handed to you, and you're learning to prioritize where your time actually pays off.

  • Experience navigating complex public procurement procedures - knowing and following the processes but also influencing them with initiative and creativity.

  • Comfort selling technical products. Experience with process automation, integration platforms, middleware, or similar technical software is a real advantage here, particularly in a Public Sector context, since you'll regularly be in the room with engineering and IT buyers.

  • Negotiation experience under real pressure. You know where to hold firm and where to flex, and you can explain your reasoning either way.

  • A relationship-building style that goes beyond the transaction. You've had customers start to treat you as an advisor, not just a vendor.

With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

At Camunda, we believe in empowering organizations to work smarter and deliver lasting impact. As an Enterprise Account Executive, you’ll champion the adoption of process automation - bringing innovation, transparency, and efficiency to Corporate customers across UKI. Join a passionate, collaborative team that values initiative, customer focus, and the drive to make a real difference on our customers’ digital transformation.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

  1. Driving ARR growth across UKI, from new business and expansion of existing customers through complex sales cycles including; technical discovery and evaluations, presentations, financial and legal negotiations, and on-site customer meetings when necessary

  2. Articulating Camunda’s value proposition and vision to multiple levels of technical and business leadership

  3. Collaboration and partnering with Camunda Solutions Engineering, Product leaders, and Partners (GSI and Regional) to understand and support customer use cases

  4. Leveraging multiple communication methods and collaboration with Account Development Representatives to create new contacts in middle and senior leadership in both technical and executive areas of the enterprise landscape.

Must Haves:

  • 6+ years of quota attainment within an Enterprise (Saas) AE role

  • 6+ years of experience selling complex software solutions to Enterprise companies by articulating business value and navigating complex buying centers across business and IT stakeholders

  • History of success selling to customers in the Banking and Financial Services. Tier 1/2.

  • Proven track record of success selling $1M+ mutli-year contracts

  • Command of Sales Methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Challenger Sales

  • Track record of building new Pipeline generation via outbound campaigns

  • Ability to manage a high performing Account Teams, driving the strategy and execution of team members

  • Strong collaborator, innovator and problem solver

  • Adhere to our FAITH values

Nice-to-haves:

  • Familiarity with Automation technology a plus

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-YW1 #LI-Remote #EMEAWest

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $281,300.00 to $453,500.00

  • United Kingdom: £176,600.00 to £290,500.00

  • Singapore: Singapore: S$349,400.00 to S$524,000.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

AI in our hiring process: Camunda may use AI tools to aid the screening of applications and during the interview process. You can learn more here

”Everyone is welcome at Camunda” — it’s a celebrated component of our culture. We strive to create an inclusive environment that empowers our people. At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. We are looking forward to your application!

Come join us and be part of Camunda’s incredible journey: Make an impact at a pivotal moment in our story!

Please be aware that scammers may impersonate Camunda by reaching out about job opportunities. Camunda will only contact candidates from an email address ending in @camunda.com or @talent.camunda.com. We will never ask candidates for bank account details, checks, payment, or other sensitive financial information as part of our hiring process. If you receive a suspicious message, please do not respond, click any links, or share personal information.

Note for recruiting and placement agencies: Camunda does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site, employees, or any other Camunda contact unless we have specifically engaged your firm for that search. Camunda will not pay fees related to unsolicited resumes.

🚀 About Nivoda

Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.

 

🌍 Our Mission

The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.

 
 

🤔 About the Role

We are looking for a Sr. Content and Social Media Manager to own our social channels and be the creative engine behind our marketing campaigns. You are a storyteller first and an operator second: you can take an idea, shape it into something people actually want to watch and share, and make it show up consistently everywhere we publish.

This is a connective role. You will own the content calendar, plan and run campaigns end to end, keep a strong and consistent presence on social, and run our newsletter. You will be the glue across marketing, making sure a campaign lands as one coherent story across social, email, and beyond rather than a set of disconnected posts. As the team grows we will add editorial depth alongside you (long-form writing and podcast production), so you can stay focused on what you do best: social, storytelling, and campaigns that move.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own Nivoda’s social media channels end to end, from strategy and calendar to publishing and community, with Instagram and our primary channels front and centre.

  • Be the main creative force behind our marketing campaigns: come up with the idea, shape the story, and make it show up consistently across every channel.

  • Own the content calendar and keep every channel in sync, so campaigns land as one coherent story rather than scattered posts.

  • Plan and run campaigns end to end: the brief, the timeline, the assets, the launch, and the follow-through.

  • Run "The Modern Jewellers Playbook", our newsletter. Own the cadence and the sends, and tie it into everything else we are publishing.

  • Turn our bigger content moments, like interviews, launches, and guides, into a steady stream of social-first content that travels.

  • Write social and short-form copy that sounds like a real person and makes independent jewellers stop scrolling.

  • Work with our designer and video partners to ship content that looks as good as it reads, and with our paid marketer to amplify what is working.

  • Be the connective tissue across marketing: link events, campaigns, and content so nothing happens in a silo.

  • Track what performs across channels and use it to sharpen the calendar. Double down on what lands, and drop what does not.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 4+ years running social and content for a brand, with real ownership of channels and campaigns rather than just scheduling posts.

  • You are a storyteller first. You know how to take an idea and make it land as a post, an email, a thread, or a reel.

  • A body of social and campaign work you are proud of, ideally including channels you grew yourself.

  • You can write. Quickly, well, and in a voice that sounds human rather than corporate.

  • Sharp project management. You can run a content calendar and several campaigns at once without dropping any threads.

  • Comfort working hands-on on a small team and building process where none exists.

  • Fluent with the tools of modern social and content work, and happy to lean on AI to move faster.

  • An instinct for what performs, and the discipline to let data settle the debates.

 

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of the jewelry industry

  • Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade and craft audience.

  • Hands-on with short-form video: you can shoot and cut a reel yourself, or confidently direct someone who can.

  • Experience running an email or newsletter program.

  • Community-building experience, online or off.

 

Our culture and what we offer

We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.

 

Our current benefits

  • 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

  • 🏡 Remote work

  • 📈 Opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying: we hire for potential and mindset, not just a checklist.

Please submit your CV in English.

 

Not quite the right role?

If this role isn't for you but you're excited about Nivoda, join our Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something's a better fit: nivoda.com/talent-pool

We are looking for a Growth and Demand Gen Lead to own how Nivoda finds and wins new jewellers. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the channels and the numbers. You will run our paid, SEO, and account-based programs yourself, and you will be the person who works out which repeatable, scalable channels actually drive qualified leads, then builds them into an engine.

We do demand gen a particular way. Rather than pushing people to a product page and hoping, we lead with genuine value: free tools, content, and resources that help jewellers run better businesses, and we let that earn the relationship. Your job is to build the acquisition machine around that model and prove, channel by channel, what works.

You will start as an individual contributor with real ownership of the function, working alongside our paid, lifecycle, and GTM engineering talent. As the channels prove out and the work grows, there is a clear path to build and lead a team beneath you.

 

What would you be doing?

  • Own net-new customer acquisition: set the demand-gen strategy, then go and execute it yourself, hands-on, across paid and beyond.

  • Run our paid channels day to day, Google and Meta to start. For now, the ad accounts are something you are in, not something you hand off.

  • Find and build repeatable, scalable channels that drive qualified leads. The goal is a system, not a string of one-off campaigns.

  • Grow our SEO and AEO (answer-engine) presence, so jewellers find us when they are looking for help, not only when we are paying to reach them.

  • Design and run account-based programs aimed at the specific jewellers we most want as customers.

  • Lean into our value-first model: point spend at free tools and content, like our Jeweller Business Health Check, rather than product pages, and build the funnel that turns that attention into signups.

  • Work inside our attribution from day one. Partner with our data and GTM engineering leads so every channel is measurable and every dollar is accountable.

  • Hand qualified leads off cleanly to the SDR team, and close the loop so you know which channels produce customers, not just clicks.

  • Raise the bar on how rigorously the whole team tests and scales growth ideas, wherever those ideas come from.

  • Report on what is working in plain terms, kill what is not, and reinvest in what is.

 

What do we need from you?

  • 5+ years in growth or demand gen, with a track record of building acquisition channels that scaled, not just managing a spend number.

  • Deep, hands-on paid expertise. You can build, run, and optimise Google and Meta campaigns yourself, today.

  • Real experience across more than one channel: paid plus some mix of SEO, ABM, lifecycle, or net-new experiments.

  • You think in systems, repeatable and measurable and scalable, and you are suspicious of any win you cannot explain or repeat.

  • Fluency with attribution and analytics. You start from the numbers and you can defend them.

  • Comfort as a hands-on IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow into leading a team.

  • A bias for experiments. You ship, measure, learn, and move, rather than planning forever.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams und externen Partnern

data.description:
At Rhoda AI, we’re building the next generation of generalist intelligent robots. We own the full robotics stack from high-performance hardware and robot systems to the infrastructure and state-of-the-art foundation world models that control our robots. Our robots are designed to be generalists capable of operating in complex, real-world environments and handling long-tail edge cases, made possible by our cutting edge research and end-to-end system design. We've raised over $450M and are investing aggressively in model research, infrastructure, hardware development, and manufacturing scale-up to make generalist robotics a reality.

Role Description:

Tier 2 Robot Pilots are trusted, high-output robot teleoperators who reliably collect high-quality

manipulation data using VR teleoperation systems. Pilots operate with minimal supervision,

consistently meet data throughput and quality standards, and can troubleshoot routine issues

(such as basic software workflow and lab operating issues). They also support researchers with

executing evaluation protocols and providing clear feedback on robot and model behavior.

 

Primary Duties

● Collect high-quality robot training data by teleoperating robotic systems using VR

equipment and hand controllers; demonstrate manipulation tasks repeatedly and

consistently.

● Meet daily performance expectations for data collection throughput, quality, and

consistency (including correct task setup and complete metadata/notes).

● Follow task specifications and SOPs precisely, maintain discipline around experiment

changes and “what changed” between sessions.

● Maintain a safe work environment and adhere to lab safety procedures at all times.

● Support evaluations by running structured evaluation protocols alongside researchers

and accurately reporting results and issues.

 

Additional Tasks:

● Troubleshoot and report issues with robot hardware/software and teleop tooling, capture

relevant logs/notes and escalate with clear reproduction steps.

● Perform basic operational maintenance per SOP (workspace reset between sessions,

calibration checks, battery swaps or component swaps as required).

● Review/annotate recordings as needed (lightweight review for quality checks, labeling

support, or spot audits).

● Participate in process improvements to increase data collection efficiency, reduce

downtime, and improve data quality.

● Occasional travel to customer/partner sites (domestic & international) to support on-site

robot data collection, including operating in new environments, coordinating with site

contacts, and following site-specific safety and security requirements.

● Occasional weekend overtime data collection (maximum one day per weekend),

balanced with flexible scheduling and time off during the week.

Required Qualifications:

● Strong VR / controller proficiency (VR gaming or similar real-time control experience).

● Ability to maintain focus while operating in VR for extended periods and follow detailed

written/video instructions.

● Comfort working hands-on with robotics equipment in a lab environment; safety-minded

and detail-oriented.

● Comfortable with Linux / command line (running programs with arguments, checking

logs).

● Ability to debug routine issues and distinguish between environment/setup vs software

vs hardware problems.

● Ability to write detailed bug reports when issues arise, document failure modes and

participate in investigative efforts to diagnose and recover quickly.

● Reliable attendance and punctuality; able to work a fixed full-time shift (AM or PM).

● Basic technical literacy: comfortable navigating computer tools, documenting work, and

communicating clearly.

● Able to stand/sit for extended periods, perform repetitive motions, and support physical

reset tasks as needed (may include lifting/moving items up to ~30 lbs, squatting/standing

during resets).

 

Preferred:

● Experience with robotics systems, lab work, automation, manufacturing/assembly, or

other precision technical work.

● Experience supporting structured experiments/evaluations with researchers or

engineers.

● Experience collecting teleop demonstration data (robots, simulators, or other real-time

control systems).

About Zelara

Most CRM marketing still blasts generic messages at scale and calls it "personalization." Our founders experienced this firsthand in senior roles at HelloFresh, Salesforce, Uber, and others. Backed by top-tier VCs, they decided to build a better way.

Zelara is an agentic lifecycle marketing platform that improves with every interaction. It works with the CRM infrastructure our customers already use, replacing static journeys and manual segmentation with a system that creates content, makes individual-level decisions, and learns from every outcome.

With bunq, Europe's second-largest neobank, we delivered +7.4% activation and +66% reactivation uplift, measured against a control group. We raised a €3M pre-seed and are generating revenue with paying enterprise customers. We are looking for a senior freelance marketer to help drive demand generation.

The Role

You work with our growth lead, the founders and sales team. Your focus is demand generation, and we measure it in pipeline: demos, opportunities created and generated pipeline value.

You work hands-on. You write, produce and publish yourself, run every initiative as an experiment, and tell us which ones to double down on stop.

Our buyers are CRM, lifecycle and marketing leaders at mid-market and enterprise B2C companies across Europe. Annual contracts run €75–250k. You are marketing to marketers, so our quality bar is high and our content needs to be excellent..

Sales owns the deal. You help to shape how a buyer first hears of us and why they take the meeting.

What You Will Do

  • Grow marketing-sourced pipeline across the necessary growth channels

  • Build the Zelara’s content engine: LinkedIn presence, blog, lead magnets, and more

  • Build reach in our niche through the newsletters, podcasts and communities our buyers already follow

  • Turn customer results into stories that sell

  • Work on AI systems across research, writing and creatives

Who You Are

  • You have a strong track record in B2B demand generation and can name the pipeline and revenue you created.

  • You have built a successful program from zero that became a reliable, measurable source of deals, such as a channel, a campaign format or a community.

  • You are an experienced marketer to marketers, ideally from a fast-growing SaaS or martech company, and know what makes them stop and read.

  • You are an exceptional creator: a sharp, clear writer, confident on video, newsletters or podcasts that people actually follow.

  • You are a strong storyteller who turns a founder's thinking into authentic content that sounds like them and gets them invited to speak.

  • You are genuinely AI-native: AI is part of how you research, write and produce, every day.

  • You are fluent in English. German is a strong bonus.

Bonus

  • You have worked at a martech or CRM vendor, or marketed to marketers.

  • You have built an audience of your own.

  • You have run events or podcasts that produced pipeline.

What We Offer

  • A long-term freelance engagement, with scope and goals agreed per quarter.

  • Direct work with the founders, growth lead, and a product with a real result to talk about.

  • Room to decide how you reach the results we agree on.

  • An AI-native working environment in a company aiming to shape the future of marketing.
